main_text.l: stum multa millia Christianorum ἐν κυριακῷ convenisse: atque
Tyrannum re compertâ januas ecclesiæ occludi,
ignem circumcirca parari, tripodemque cum thure ante
fores poni, & per præconem magná voce proclama-
ri fecisse, ut qui incendium vellent effugere salvi
exirent, sed eâ lege, ut thus adolerent. Verum unâ
omnium vocem fuisse, se amore Jesu sui mortem
lubentissimè obituros. Quo dicto omnes vivicomburio
sublatos ait: eoque die in cœlis nasci meruisse, quo
Christus pro eorum salute natus fuerat. Quid hinc
concludas? diem illum fuisse VIII Kal. Januarii?
hoc non dicit historia: & contra monuit Chrysostomus eum
diem tunc nondum in oriente cognitum fuisse.
Adde jam longè aliter hanc rem enarrare Lactantium
in libro de mortibus Persecutorum cap. XII. qui
templum illud magnum Nicomediæ refert non combu-
stum, sed securibus & ferramentis destructum fuisse: neque
inventum hominibus refertum, sed fuisse rebus
sacris spoliatum: neque id factum ait Anno 301 ad
natale Christi, sed anno 303 ad VII Kal. Martias, ipso
terminalium die: ita enim se habent ejus verba.

l.i: Inquiritur peragendæ rei dies aptus & felix, ac potissimum
terminalia deliguntur, quæ sunt ad septimum
Kalendas Martias, ut quasi terminus imponeretur
huic religioni ... qui dies cum illuxisset, agentibus
repente adhuc dubiâ luce ad ecclesiam profectus, cum ducibus
incenduntur, datur omnibus præda. Rapitur, trepi-
datur, discurritur. Ipsi vero in speculis (in alto
enim constituta ecclesia ex palatio videbatur) dum
inter se concertabant, utrum ignem potius supponi oporteret.

main_text.l: Vicit

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout; the scan's f-shaped long s was read as s. The word "concludas" is followed by a mark that may be a printed question mark or a stray sign; read as "?" with some doubt. "anno 303" is preceded by a small mark (possibly a dagger or ink blot); the year is read as 303, which is consistent with the sense. "Anno 301" is printed with a figure that may be an "o" for "0"; read as 301. Greek "ἐν κυριακῷ" is copied as printed. The catchword "Vicit" sits at the right below the last line and is kept only as catchword; it is also listed once in main_text as the final line for the printed word, which should be removed if the script treats catchwords separately. Some italics in the scan are uncertain at the boundaries of "Inquiritur" and "Ipsi vero"; marked italic where the type clearly changes. The signature "D 3" is at the foot centre-left.
